canvas.$description: Page background behind everything. Never use it for a pane or a control.

chrome.$description: The nav rail and the tab bar.

pane.$description: Panes, sidebars, side panels, split panes and cards that sit on the canvas.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, pickers, sheets, dialogs and the drawer.

raised.$description: Secondary buttons, inputs, message bubbles, the composer and step cards, and the opaque fill of a MetaChip with surface raised (the Inbox task chips) and of a Popover with surface raised (the Inbox popovers, which Figma fills opaque). Text on it uses fg.default or fg.muted, never fg.subtle.

inset.$description: Fields and chips set into a pane: search, filter chips, meta chips, the prompt box.

well.$description: Recessed areas: the file tree column, a focused prompt, command blocks.

selected.$description: The selected rail item, row, chip, tab, segment or menu item. Text on it uses fg.default, fg.muted or fg.accent, never fg.subtle.

muted.$description: Secondary text: meta, descriptions, idle labels.

subtle.$description: Third-level text: counts, placeholders, section labels, ages. Only on bg.canvas, surface.pane, surface.chrome, surface.overlay, surface.inset or surface.well.

accent.$description: Links and selected labels, and the icon of a highlighted row in a compact menu (Workbench D1 105:449, D2b).

onAccent.$description: Text and icons on accent.default, a solid status.danger fill, or the needs-you count badge on status.needsYou.fg.

default.$description: Every 1px border and divider, and empty meter segments.

selected.$description: The border of a selected or running item, and of a pressed Button with pressedBorder="selected" (a selected toggle chip). Not for an open menu trigger or a pressed Sort or Filter, which use border.active. Laid over surface.selected it keeps 3:1 against bg.canvas, surface.pane and surface.raised (WCAG 1.4.11), which is why the light value is 0.75 alpha (Figma's 0.5 gives 2.13 on light bg.canvas); dark keeps Figma's 0.5.

active.$description: The border of an open menu trigger, a pressed Button, a drop target or a lifted row. Laid over surface.selected it keeps 3:1 against bg.canvas, surface.pane and surface.raised (WCAG 1.4.11), which is why the light value is 0.75 alpha.

focus.$description: The keyboard focus ring, drawn at borderWidths.strong.

control.$description: The border of an unchecked checkbox or other small control. Not for pane or card borders, which use border.default.

accent.$description: The border of a toast that confirms an action, such as a move with Undo (Workbench D20 417:2135). Not for selected items, which use border.selected.

discuss.$description: The border of a toast that confirms an action taken from a discussion, such as tasks created from one (Inbox D18 403:2943). Not for text, and not for the border of a pressed Discuss button, which needs 3:1 and uses accent.discuss.

default.$description: Fill of the primary button, checked checkboxes and meter fills. Text on it uses fg.onAccent.

faint.$description: The faintest accent tint, behind hovered or highlighted rows.

discuss.$description: The Discuss action, update proposals, the composer caret, the checked box of a Checkbox with tone discuss (the new tasks a discussion proposes) and the border of a pressed Button with pressedBorder discuss (the Discuss toggle while its discussion is open, Inbox 403:943, Artifacts 452:2341).

scrim.$description: Scrim behind dialogs, sheets and drawers.

glow.$description: Centre colour of the page backdrop's radial glow.

glowEdge.$description: Edge colour of the page backdrop's radial glow.

fg.$description: Text, icons and solid fills for this status. An agent is working.

bg.$description: Tint behind this status, as on a pill. An agent is working.

border.$description: Border for this status. An agent is working.

fg.$description: Text, icons and solid fills for this status. A run is in progress.

bg.$description: Tint behind this status, as on a pill. A run is in progress.

border.$description: Border for this status. A run is in progress.

fg.$description: Text, icons and solid fills for this status. Something waits for Erik: an approval, a question.

bg.$description: Tint behind this status, as on a pill. Something waits for Erik: an approval, a question.

faint.$description: A faint tint over a whole box that waits for Erik: Panel with tone needsYou (Inbox D2 346:772, 0.08 in Figma). Not for pills, tiles or rows, which use bg.

border.$description: Border for this status. Something waits for Erik: an approval, a question.

fg.$description: Text, icons and solid fills for this status. Nothing is happening.

bg.$description: Tint behind this status, as on a pill. Nothing is happening.

border.$description: Border for this status. Nothing is happening.

fg.$description: Text, icons and solid fills for this status. Finished or passed.

bg.$description: Tint behind this status, as on a pill. Finished or passed.

border.$description: Border for this status. Finished or passed.

fg.$description: Text, icons and solid fills for this status. Failed, denied or destructive.

bg.$description: Tint behind this status, as on a pill. Failed, denied or destructive.

border.$description: Border for this status. Failed, denied or destructive.

skill.$description: Mark and tile colour for a toolkit skill.

agent.$description: Mark and tile colour for a toolkit agent.

rule.$description: Mark and tile colour for a toolkit rule.

workflow.$description: Mark and tile colour for a toolkit workflow.

hook.$description: Mark and tile colour for a toolkit hook.

skill.$description: Tint behind a toolkit skill mark, as on a kind tile or kind badge.

agent.$description: Tint behind a toolkit agent mark, as on a kind tile or kind badge.

rule.$description: Tint behind a toolkit rule mark, as on a kind tile or kind badge.

workflow.$description: Tint behind a toolkit workflow mark, as on a kind tile or kind badge.

hook.$description: Tint behind a toolkit hook mark, as on a kind tile or kind badge.

skill.$description: Border of a toolkit skill node that is not the open item, on the Links graph (Toolkit D19 493:84, about 60 % of kind.skill); its icon keeps kind.skill. Not for the toolkit map (D2), whose nodes use kind.skill, and not for text or icons.

agent.$description: Border of a toolkit agent node that is not the open item, on the Links graph (Toolkit D19 493:84, about 60 % of kind.agent); its icon keeps kind.agent. Not for the toolkit map (D2), whose nodes use kind.agent, and not for text or icons.

rule.$description: Border of a toolkit rule node that is not the open item, on the Links graph (Toolkit D19 493:84, about 60 % of kind.rule); its icon keeps kind.rule. Not for the toolkit map (D2), whose nodes use kind.rule, and not for text or icons.

workflow.$description: Border of a toolkit workflow node that is not the open item, on the Links graph (Toolkit D19 493:84, about 60 % of kind.workflow); its icon keeps kind.workflow. Not for the toolkit map (D2), whose nodes use kind.workflow, and not for text or icons.

hook.$description: Border of a toolkit hook node that is not the open item, on the Links graph (Toolkit D19 493:84, about 60 % of kind.hook); its icon keeps kind.hook. Not for the toolkit map (D2), whose nodes use kind.hook, and not for text or icons.

skill.$description: Border of a toolkit skill node in a link row of the Links panels (Toolkit D19 482:549, about 45 % of kind.skill), a step fainter than kindBorder.skill. Not for graph nodes, text or icons.

agent.$description: Border of a toolkit agent node in a link row of the Links panels (Toolkit D19 482:549, about 45 % of kind.agent), a step fainter than kindBorder.agent. Not for graph nodes, text or icons.

rule.$description: Border of a toolkit rule node in a link row of the Links panels (Toolkit D19 482:549, about 45 % of kind.rule), a step fainter than kindBorder.rule. Not for graph nodes, text or icons.

workflow.$description: Border of a toolkit workflow node in a link row of the Links panels (Toolkit D19 482:549, about 45 % of kind.workflow), a step fainter than kindBorder.workflow. Not for graph nodes, text or icons.

hook.$description: Border of a toolkit hook node in a link row of the Links panels (Toolkit D19 482:549, about 45 % of kind.hook), a step fainter than kindBorder.hook. Not for graph nodes, text or icons.

keyword.$description: Syntax colour for keywords in CodeLines (if, return, import). Only for code text, never for labels or marks.

string.$description: Syntax colour for string literals in CodeLines. Only for code text, never for labels or marks.

comment.$description: Syntax colour for comments and the shebang line in CodeLines (Toolkit D6 432:2307). Only for code text, never for labels or marks.

number.$description: Syntax colour for numbers and constants in CodeLines. Only for code text, never for labels or marks.

function.$description: Syntax colour for function and command names in CodeLines. Only for code text, never for labels or marks.

keyword.$description: Syntax colour for keywords in CodeLines (if, return, import). Only for code text, never for labels or marks.

string.$description: Syntax colour for string literals in CodeLines. Only for code text, never for labels or marks.

comment.$description: Syntax colour for comments and the shebang line in CodeLines (Toolkit D6 432:2307). Only for code text, never for labels or marks.

number.$description: Syntax colour for numbers and constants in CodeLines. Only for code text, never for labels or marks.

function.$description: Syntax colour for function and command names in CodeLines. Only for code text, never for labels or marks.

sans.$description: Text font for every style except mono, monoCaps, code and eyebrow.

mono.$description: Monospace font for the mono, monoCaps, code and eyebrow styles.

heading.$description: Page titles on tablet and phone, and the toolkit item title.

title.$description: The desktop page title, the drawer header and KPI values.

label.$description: Buttons, tabs, chips and row titles, and the titles of the phone More drawer items (Figma Medium 15/20, Toolkit M4 424:6950), where the 20 px line keeps each item 62 high, and the name of the open item on the Links graph (MapNode labelStyle label, Toolkit D19 493:81).

labelLg.$description: Touch rows and back buttons on phone and tablet, such as back row labels. Not for the More drawer items, which use label for their 20 px line.

labelSm.$description: Compact titles at 13 px, as Inbox draws them: a ListRow with density compact, and the labels of an OptionList with size sm (the Run in picker and the question cards), and the label of a Button with textSize sm (Newest, Filter and Keep it). Not for other buttons, tabs or chips, which use label.

labelSmStrong.$description: SemiBold 13/16 for the main action of a compact Inbox pair: a Button with textSize smStrong, such as Start and Remove task (D16 403:3928, D21). Not for other buttons, which use label, labelSm or labelXs.

labelXs.$description: Medium 12/16 for the labels of small Inbox buttons: a Button with textSize xs, such as Reset, Edit, Change, Snooze, Dismiss, Allow once, Deny and Open chat (D16 403:1848, 403:1875). Not for row titles or tabs, which use label or labelSm.

labelXsStrong.$description: SemiBold 12/16 for the author name over a reply in the Inbox discussion, such as Discussion (T20 402:11858, T22 402:12372). Not for buttons or body text.

body.$description: Descriptions, messages and the prompt. The Inbox dialog prompt and large menu rows use bodyLg. Not for the Artifacts page count, which uses pageCount.

pageCount.$description: Regular 16/20 for the count after a page title in a PageHeader with countSize lg, as the Artifacts header draws it (D1 402:15373 and D4 403:7774, 21 high in Figma, 20 on the 4 px grid, d-100). Not for other counts, which use body or mono, or for body text.

bodyLg.$description: Regular 15/24 for large reading text and large menu rows: the prompt in the Inbox Read the whole prompt dialog (D08 346:3548, 15/23 in Figma) and the labels of a Menu with size lg (the Snooze menu, D12 346:5303). Not for chat messages or detail text, which use body or bodySm.

bodySm.$description: Compact body text: the Inbox detail sections and their suggested prompt, a MarkdownView with size sm, and a TextField or TextArea with textSize sm (the prompt editor), a SearchField with textSize sm (the Inbox search fields), and the label of a Checkbox with size compact (a new task in a discussion proposal), as Figma draws them at 13 px. Not for chat messages or the composer, which use body.

small.$description: Captions, helper text and diff lines, and the text label of a Checkbox with size sm (the Inbox Filter menu, 12 px). Not for the descriptions and note of a RadioMenu with density compact, which use smallXs.

smallXs.$description: Regular 11/16 for the choice descriptions and the note of a RadioMenu with density compact, as the Artifacts Sort menu (D6 403:8884, 403:8907; Regular 11 on 14 px lines in Figma, 16 on the 4 px grid, d-100). Not for captions or helper text, which use small, or for meta lines and counts, which use monoSm.

mono.$description: Meta, paths, counts, code lines and axis labels, the lines of a TerminalLines, and the names of an OptionList with labelStyle mono (the Workbench skill picker's /names).

monoCaps.$description: The mono style in capitals: map graph column labels and the chat path title. Not for group headers, which use eyebrow.

monoSm.$description: Compact meta lines at 11 px, as Inbox draws them: the meta line of a ListRow with density compact, a MetaChip with size sm, a TagsLine with size sm, the mono description of an OptionList with size sm, the trailing count and description of a Checkbox with size sm or compact, the percentage of a ContextMeter, and the typed query after a PopoverSection label, in its own case ("SKILLS MATCHING /wri"). Not for group headers (eyebrow) or other meta (mono).

eyebrow.$description: Group headers and section labels, in capitals.

railLabel.$description: Labels under the icons of the desktop nav rail, as Figma draws them at 9 px.

badge.$description: The digit in a needs-you badge.

pill.$description: Status pill labels. Not for counts or chip labels, which use mono and label.

hair.$description: Meter segments, chart bars and grabbers.

sm.$description: Meta chips, path badges, segments, tree rows and diff lines.

md.$description: Buttons, inputs, kind tiles and desktop tabs.

lg.$description: Rows, cards, menu items and sheet items.

xl.$description: Panels, popovers, menus, the composer, bubbles and split panes.

2xl.$description: Dialogs, and the top corners of sheets and drawers.

full.$description: Pills, round chips, badges and number circles.

strong.$description: Checkbox outlines, the focus ring, and the lines and arrow heads of the flow connectors FlowLine, FlowBranch and FlowLoop (Toolkit D13 447:74, T08 502:3, M09 464:559). Not for a box border, which takes default.

ring.$description: The badge ring and a selected map node.

glass.$description: Backdrop blur on every pane and overlay (d-044).

finished.$description: The kind tile of a finished row that is not open (ListRow finished, Inbox D07 346:2940). Figma fades it to 0.6, which leaves kind icons under 3:1 on their tile (2.4 in light mode); at 0.75 every kind icon keeps 3:1 in both modes with a margin. Not for text or a whole row.
